name: XBULKiT – Bulk Edit WooCommerce Products, Variations, Orders, Coupons and WordPress Posts & Pages
author: ithemelandco

sections.description:
XBULKiT – edit bundle Plugin is an awesome plugin for WordPress. It has 5 modules for bulk editing and helps you to Save Time & Easily Manage WooCommerce & WordPress Data. This means you are able to manage posts and custom posts, woocommerce products, woocommerce orders, and coupons in wordpress.

5 Premium Plugins Included:

  • PBULKiT – Bulk Edit WooCommerce Products
  • VBULKiT – Bulk Edit WooCommerce Variations
  • OBULKiT – Bulk Edit WooCommerce Orders
  • WPBULKiT – Bulk Edit WordPress Posts & Pages
  • CBULKiT – Advanced Bulk Coupons For WooCommerce

Why do you need XBULKiT?

✅ Saving your time:

  • Bulk editing everything in the wordpress and woocommerce at one time
  • Filter, select and change specific posts, products, orders, and coupon
  • Bind editing: With this option, you can set the same value of edited posts, products, orders, and coupon to other selected rows. This will help you edit several posts, products, orders, and coupon at once and will result in a faster editing and save a huge amount of your time!
  • Delete multiple posts, products, orders, and coupon: You can select multiple posts and choose to either delete them permanently, or if you think you might need to use them later, it is possible to move them to the trash and access these posts later.
  • Duplicate posts, products, orders, and coupon: If you want to duplicate posts or custom posts, you can clone them and duplicate all of the selected posts with just one click.
  • Save search queries for later use: You can save the most used search queries for later use (or any search query you want). This way, you don’t have to choose the search options every time, and with just two clicks you can use your most used search queries to find the posts, products, orders, and coupon you need.

✅ Easily scale-up your site:

  • Import and export according to your requirements
  • Make a customized column for edit table
  • Use a spreadsheet to control, manage and edit numerous posts at the same time:
    • View all your posts, products, orders, and coupon simultaneously
    • Edit posts, products, orders, and coupon easily
    • Create a lot of posts, products, orders, and coupon at once
    • Copy information between posts quicker
    • And more…

✅ Support all of fields

  • Support all of WordPress and WooCommerce fields and custom fields
  • Support all of categories, tags, and taxonomies

Key Features

  • User friendly design
  • Support all of posts, products, orders, and coupon
  • Filtering by all wordpress and woocommerce data fields :: title, category, taxonomy, …
  • Advanced bulk editing form: edit all wordpress posts, products, orders, and coupon fields in specific operands :
    • Append, prepend, replace for text fields :: title, link and …
    • Increase, decrease for numberic fields
    • Calculator for decimal values
    • Featured image and gallery
    • Date picker for date fields
    • Multiple selection :: category, taxonomy, tag
    • And …
  • Show/Hide columns
  • Column manager:
    • Set color and BG color for columns
    • Set custom label for columns
  • Create posts, products, orders, and coupon
  • Duplicate posts, products, orders, and coupon
  • Delete several posts, products, orders, and coupon with one click.
  • Set category and taxonomy for multiple posts and products at once
  • Inline edit: edit values in separate types: numeric, text, date, checkbox and …
  • Save search form query
  • Add custom fields / taxonomy as columns, search field and bulk edit field
  • Import / Export
  • Binded editing : edit several posts, products, orders, and coupon at once.
  • History: Save all of change log beside of Undo / Redo :: You can revert your changes.
  • Sticky column: fix ID column
  • Find duplicate posts, products, orders, and coupon and delete all of them easily
  • Support all WordPress and WooCommerce fields

Check demo version: Pro Version
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/plugin-name directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. After Install and Activate this plugin a menu will be added in your admin menu named “iT Bulk Editing” that is included 4 submenus as:
    a- Dashboard
    b- Woo Coupons
    c- Add-Ons
sections.faq:
How to check this plugin before purchasing that?

There are two ways to check the XBULKiT plugin before buying:

Build Test Drive
Build Test-Drive(Amin Demo) and work with plugins in a real environment. For this, Please go to plugin page and then click the Live Preview button to enter the plugin demo page. In the top bar that appears, click Launch Admin Demo. A popup will appear asking you to enter your email and submit the form. The relevant link will be sent to your email now.

What are the required systems for XBULKiT plugin?

PHP compatibility: from 7.x
WordPress compatibility: from v5.x to the latest WordPress version.

Where can I get the premium version of this plugin?

Please check XBULKiT plugin

How I can translate XBULKiT plugin to other languages?

You can use this plugin in any language, this means you can translate this plugin to another language.

There is a translate file in the “Language” folder as ‘.pot’ extension.

You can easily translate the plugin into the desired languages by using translation plugins such as WPML and Loco Translate.

Can we use this plugin on multiple sites?

Yes! As you know, XBULKiT plugin is a premium product that is sold through the codecanyon store. For each purchase, you will be assigned a purchase code and you can use this purchase code on only one website, so to use the XBULKiT plugin on your various websites, you need to separate license for each site.

What is your refund policy?

If you believe that you’ve bought the wrong product and the purchased product is useless, you can send a refund request for that. Within 30 days of purchase, iThemelandCo will Refund your money.

I have an idea, can I discuss it with you?

Please leave your message in our support system
